title: raw URL preserved
setup: browser watcher over a Chromium history fixture; every visit URL carries tracking params, odd encoding and a fragment.
expected: payload.url is byte-identical to the visit for every event; text differs from payload.url wherever a param was stripped.

wrong.label: payload-url-rewritten
wrong.assert_absent: payload.url differing in any byte from the visit's URL
